entities.name: Chinghiz Aitmatov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chinghiz Torekulovich Aitmatov was a Kyrgyz author who wrote mainly in Russian, but also in Kyrgyz. He is one of the best known figures in Kyrgyzstan's literature.
